snippet.title: The Occultist - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A Developer Interview/Gameplay Trailer for The Occultist. The Occultist is a First Person Narrative Thriller that centres on the paranormal. In this video the develoers explain more about the in game world and the central character Alan Rebels. The Occultist is coming to PC, Ps5, Xbox Series X/S in 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092840/The_Occultist/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
